name: Benim Adim Aylamaz
overview: The story revolves around two contrasting women whose lives become unexpectedly intertwined across Istanbul and Macedonia. Aylamaz (Yağmur Tanrısevsin) is a highly successful but deeply lonely obstetrician in Istanbul whose only confidant is an artificial intelligence partner. Her life pivots when she discovers ancient family roots tied to Kayalı Village in Macedonia. There, she meets Mevlüde (Ceyda Ateş), a resilient woman raising a child alone following the tragic death of her husband, whose destiny is tied to mystical seeds and a generational curse.
